title: Combat.spend('action') now calls require_action and then repeats the is_turn and can_act checks right after it. Fold the remaining checks so each refusal is written in one place.

history.summary: The "not your turn" and "can't act while Incapacitated" refusals are now written once, in a new helper `Combat._require_turn` (dungdra/combat.py). `require_action` calls it before its own action-available and Action Surge/Magic checks. In `spend()`, "action" goes through `require_action` only, and "bonus"/"free" go through `_require_turn` only, so the checks no longer run twice. Refusal wording and order are unchanged. I added unit tests for three things: spend('action'|'bonus'|'free') is refused off-turn and while Incapacitated with nothing spent; a bonus action is refused the second time in a turn; and so is a second free object interaction. Unit tests pass (420), the full suite passes (780), ruff check and ruff format --check are clean, and dev-gate passes. The first dev-gate run failed because changed line dungdra/combat.py:176 had too little unit-test coverage (changed lines 88% covered, gate needs 90%). The second test closed that gap and the re-run passed. The ticket listed no acceptance tests, so there was nothing to run with --runxfail. This is a pure refactor with no rule change, so I added no SRD tags.
